newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies six muni bond issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies six muni bond issues for insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp on Monday said that it qualifed for bond insurance the following six municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today:
--Monticello CSD, Iowa $4.450 million General Obligation bonds.
--Plymouth, Mich., $4.995 million General Obligation bonds (GOs), bidders' option.
--Pearland, Texas, Certificates of Obligation, $6.250 million, bidders' option.
--Beloit, Wisc., $2.48 million GO Prom., direct purchase.
--Menomonie, Wis., $2.745 million GO Prom., direct purchase.
